plugins.description: **kunglao-agent is an autonomous reverse-engineering system. You hand it a target and the questions you need answered; it works the problem for hours or days on its own — planning its own path, recovering from worker deaths, resuming after crashes — and converges only when every answer is derived from raw evidence and survives mechanical verification gates.**
